extracted.intended_audience: organisational leaders, HR and engagement practitioners, managers (internal communications / employee engagement)
extracted.subtask_description: A short organisational framework listing four key enablers that improve employee engagement: strategic narrative, engaging managers, employee voice, and organisational integrity. Intended as guidance for leaders, managers and internal communications teams.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strategic narrative
rubrics_metrics.description: Strategic narrative – Visible, empowering leadership providing a strong strategic narrative about the organisation, where it’s come from and where it’s going.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Visible, empowering leadership providing a strong strategic narrative about the organisation, where it’s come from and where it’s going.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engaging managers
rubrics_metrics.description: Engaging managers – Managers who focus, coach and stretch their people, giving them scope and treating them as individuals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Managers who focus, coach and stretch their people, giving them scope and treating them as individuals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Employee voice
rubrics_metrics.description: Employee voice – Employees have a voice throughout the organisation for reinforcing and challenging views, between functions and externally.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Employees are seen not as the problem, but as central to the solution – to be involved, listened to and invited to contribute their experience, expertise and ideas. Employees have a voice throughout the organisation for reinforcing and challenging views, between functions and externally.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integrity
rubrics_metrics.description: Integrity – Organisational integrity – the values on the wall are reflected in day-to-day behaviours. There is no ‘say-do’ gap.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organisational integrity – the values on the wall are reflected in day-to-day behaviours. There is no ‘say-do’ gap. Promises made and promises kept, or an explanation given as to why not.
